# Project Guidelines

## Overview

This is a Warframe game data pipeline that pulls data from community APIs and official exports, then transforms it into Spark AI-readable Markdown documentation for the CommunityOne Discord bot.

**Two-stage pipeline:**
1. `pull.js` — Fetches raw JSON from APIs and npm packages into `data/`
2. `transform.js` — Converts JSON into structured `.md` files in `docs/`

## Architecture

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `pull.js` | Data fetcher — HTTP calls + npm package reads → `data/*.json` |
| `transform.js` | JSON → Markdown converter — `data/*.json` → `docs/*.md` |
| `data/` | Raw JSON (gitignored, regenerated by `npm run pull`) |
| `docs/` | AI-readable Markdown (synced to Spark AI / CommunityOne) |

### Data Sources (npm packages)

- `@wfcd/items` — All Warframe items (17k+), CJS require
- `@wfcd/patchlogs` — Patch notes, read from `data/patchlogs.json`
- `@wfcd/relics` — Relic generator (async `.generate()`)
- `warframe-worldstate-data` — Worldstate reference, ESM-only (use dynamic `import()`)
- `warframe-public-export-plus` — DE public export, CJS require
- `warframe-riven-info` — Riven tags, read JSON directly from `node_modules`
- Drop tables API — `https://drops.warframestat.us/data/all.json`

## Code Style

- CommonJS (`require`) for all scripts — except `warframe-worldstate-data` which requires dynamic `import()`
- JSHint for linting (see `.jshintrc`): enforce curly braces, quote consistency, no unused vars
- No TypeScript, no build step, no bundler
- Flat helper functions, no classes or abstractions

## Build and Test

```bash
npm run pull        # Fetch fresh JSON data from all sources
npm run transform   # Convert JSON → Spark AI markdown docs
npm run update      # Both in sequence
npm run lint        # JSHint
npm run validate    # npm ls (dependency check)
```

## Conventions

### Adding a new data source

1. Install the package: `npm i -S <package>`
2. In `pull.js`: add a numbered section that loads and writes JSON to `data/`
3. In `transform.js`: add a `transformXxx()` function, call it from `main()`
4. Update the index in `writeIndex()` with a new ToC entry

### Markdown output format (for Spark AI)

- Every `.md` file starts with `# Title` + a 1-2 sentence description paragraph
- Use `##` for each item/entry, `###` for sub-sections (abilities, crafting, etc.)
- Use Markdown tables for stats and drop tables, not raw JSON
- Include names AND descriptions — Spark works best with natural language text
- Escape pipe characters in table cells with `\|`

### Data shape gotchas

- Mission rewards: some nodes use rotation letters (`A`/`B`/`C` as arrays), others use numeric keys (flat object of individual rewards)
- Public export names are language keys (`/Lotus/Language/...`) — resolve via `dict_en.json`
- `warframe-worldstate-data` default export has locale sub-objects mixed with data keys; check `wsd.locales` array to distinguish
